The layer-2 spike is 61.9, within the 31.7 – 64.0 range for system-prompted and far above the other categories (at most 6.1). KL 0.265, top-1 agreement 0.883, layer-16 relative L2 0.409 with onset at layer 9, cosine 0.877, mid-layer size ratio 0.975 and activation-to-logit ratio 1.7 also fit system-prompted.
